sketch.name: AppTopBar
sketch.description: The enterprise application top bar: breadcrumb, data freshness, global search, environment badge, alerts bell and the signed-in user, 48 px high and docked to the top.

props.name: breadcrumb
props.description: The path to the current page; the last crumb is the page itself.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: The hint in the empty search box.

props.name: environment
props.description: The environment badge: UAT amber, DEV blue, PROD red outline; None hides it.

props.name: alertCount
props.description: The count on the bell; hidden at 0, 9+ above 9.

props.name: userRole
props.description: The signed-in user's role, under the name.

props.name: asOfText
props.description: The time the data is as of; empty hides Data as of.

props.name: asOfStale
props.description: Shows the data as stale: amber dot and · stale.

sketch.notes: Simple control (no items, rows or library). Docks to the top, 48 px high, 1 px bottom border. Under 900 px wide the name/role hide; under 600 px Data as of hides and the search collapses to a magnifier button that expands it over the breadcrumb (Esc or blur when empty closes it). Colours follow the GridKrafter palette: surfaces, text, borders, hover and accent are the theme's; live/stale/warn/info/danger are mixin colour tokens. Poet Biofuels enterprise shell.
